description: Learned overcomplete shared dictionary and sample-dependent overlapping group gates. Two active groups, union counts shared atoms once, top-four coordinate cap. Flat top-four sparse autoencoders with 12 or 22 atoms are controls. Fit and select on primitive+AND head activations only; six XOR queries completely withheld from featurizer fit and validation. Native model trained on all tasks. Five model seeds, independent test and token-frequency shift.
